record.oneLiner: Vonage provides communications and messaging APIs (SMS, Voice, Video, Verify) authenticated via API keys and JWTs, with an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
record.verdictReason: Vonage offers a comprehensive, broad set of programmable communications and messaging REST APIs that can be accessed via a self-serve free sign-up account. APIs use API key/secret pairs or application-signed JWTs, and Vonage even provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

evidence.quote: Basic Authentication sends your API Key and API Secret Base64-encoded in the Authorization header. You can find these credentials in your API settings in the Vonage Dashboard.
Generate a JWT signed with your Application ID and private key. You can use the JWT Generator, the Vonage CLI, or any Vonage SDK.
To use it you will need a Vonage account. Sign up for free at vonage.com.
The Verify API is our next generation two-factor authentication (2FA) product. Authenticate your users and prevent fraud with our simple, easy-to-use API...
The Vonage MCP Server enables AI agents and developer tools to discover, describe, and use Vonage capabilities via the Model Context Protocol.
